name: This Portfolio (AI Portfolio)
description: An AI-first personal portfolio: a RAG-backed chat interface grounded in structured, version-controlled data, with a classic landing page as the alternate mode.

name: InfantHealthRisk
description: A FastAPI-based ML backend for early risk detection in newborns in neonatal intensive care. Uses a CatBoost model with JWT authentication and MongoDB storage to classify overall, cardiac, respiratory, and jaundice risk as Low/Medium/High, intended as clinical decision support rather than a diagnostic tool.

name: Bird Species Recognition
description: Bird species recognition from audio recordings: trains a classifier on labeled bird sound clips and supports prediction from an audio file or live from a microphone.
